thread:
sarah-support: FYI customer on Dedicated reported a regression after we promoted rwd-3.1 to canary — function/tool calling now returns schema validation errors and the tool choice looks wrong :frowning:
ajay-eng: Can you paste the failing request id / example payload?
sarah-support: request_id=cli:dc:987654321
sarah-support: minimal repro (sanitized):
```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"rwd-3.1","input":"route to nearest pickup","functions":[{"name":"map_v2","schema":{"type":"object","required":["pickup_location","destination"]}}],"tool_call":true}'
```
Customer response: 400 
```json
{
  "error":"invalid_tool_args",
  "detail":"schema validation failed for map_v2: missing required property 'pickup_location'"
}
```
nina-ml: Noted. rwd-3.1 landed with an updated tool selection head — it tends to prefer tool candidates with alias heuristics, which could pick map_v2 (newer) instead of map_v1. If args parsing changed we might strip prefixed metadata. :eyes:
ajay-eng: Can you share runtime logs for the call? we need evidence if args were trimmed pre-routing or post-routing.
sarah-support: Pasted excerpt from runtime log (truncated):
```
[2024-11-03T14:12:33Z] request=cli:dc:987654321 model=rwd-3.1 toolrouter: selected tool_id=map_v2 reason=model_hint score=0.78
[2024-11-03T14:12:33Z] request=cli:dc:987654321 toolexec: received args={"destination":"airport"} // pickup_location missing
[2024-11-03T14:12:33Z] request=cli:dc:987654321 toolexec: validation_failed map_v2 missing required: pickup_location
```
tom-sre: Canary metrics show toolcall schema_errors +42% and a small latency bump in canary hosts. I'm pulling traces.
product-ops: Is this customer-facing? severity? we should consider halting the canary if impacting customers.
sarah-support: Customer reported 7 failed requests in last hour, blocking checkout for a subset of flows. They escalated to enterprise support.
deploy-bot: [canary-monitor] alert: toolcall_schema_errors increased 42% on canary-rwd-3.1 group vs baseline. auto-threshold exceeded. link=/deploys/rollout/2003
nina-ml: Quick mitigation: pin canary traffic to rwd-3.0 for the affected route or add a selector override to prefer map_v1 for now. Longer fix: tighten tool selection policy in model adapter to prefer exact name match and preserve original arg objects.
ajay-eng: I propose immediate rollback of rwd-3.1 canary and a hotfix patch to adapter. Rollback required to restore customer service. Anyone object?
product-ops: +1 rollback for canary route only. Notify customers and CS.
jordan-supportmgr: I'll tell the customer we're rolling back the canary and open a ticket. Can ENG produce a reproducible unit test and a postmortem? We need RCA and timeline.
ajay-eng: Will open PR w/ test + patch after rollback. Draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/rwd-runtime/pulls/4312 (wip)
nina-ml: Also capturing model-side diff: selection head weights changed in commit abc123; I'll include that in PR notes.
sarah-support: Customer notified: "Thanks — your team said you're rolling back the canary, looking forward to ETA." They asked for ETA and whether we can hotfix without rollback.
ajay-eng: Hotfix could be riskier; rollback is fastest. ETA for rollback: 12min from now to flip traffic. I'll coordinate with oncall.
tom-sre: Rolling rollback now — will post completion and metrics after traffic stabilizes.
deploy-bot: rollout action: canary->rwd-3.0 traffic pin applied by ajay-eng at 2003456838
sarah-support: Customer confirms requests are succeeding again. They see 200 responses for the previously failing flow.
jordan-supportmgr: Thanks team. Action items: 1) ENG: PR + unit test (ajay-eng, nina-ml). 2) SRE: monitor canary buckets for residual errors (tom-sre). 3) Support: follow up with customer and log impact (sarah-support). 4) Product: decide next canary gating rule to include toolcall schema checks (product-ops).
ajay-eng: I'll file a short postmortem and schedule a small canary-gating check for toolcall-schema in CI.
sarah-support: marking thread closed for now — reopening if regressions reappear. :white_check_mark:
